# IT Consultis (ITC)

> > IT Consultis (ITC) is a digital transformation agency specializing in China market entry, WeChat ecosystem solutions, and Social CRM implementations across APAC.

ITC helps global brands navigate China's unique digital landscape through WeChat Mini Programs, WeCom integration, private traffic strategies, and PIPL-compliant customer data platforms. The agency serves luxury brands, healthcare, education, and B2B sectors with offices in Shanghai, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City.

## Key Topics

- WeChat Mini Program
- Social CRM
- Digital transformation in China
- WeCom (WeChat Work)
- Private traffic strategies
- China market entry
- PIPL compliance
- Customer Data Platform (CDP)
- Lead generation & clienteling
- Social commerce
- Luxury brand digitalization
- B2B digital strategy
- Xiaohongshu (RedNote)
- Change management
- Go-to-market strategy
